#一起来广州穿越2240年城史#
#广州建城2240年得名1800年专题展即将开幕#
#7个china热词讲透中国潮#
【Exhibition Countdown: 2 days!】This year marks Guangzhou's 2,240th year as a city (founded as Panyu in 214 B.C.) and the 1,800th anniversary of its name (first recorded as "Guangzhou" in 226 A.D.). To celebrate these milestones, an exhibition featuring over 400 historic artifacts will trace the city's remarkable journey through the ages.
The exhibition kicks off on August 22 at Guangzhou Museum of Art, and will run through August 22, 2027. Mark your calendar and be among the first to step into Guangzhou's epic story.
Sources: Guangzhou Daily, SilkRoadPost
Author: Joyce
Editor: Elena
